---
title: Customize the look of a page
subtitle: Tweak the major CSS settings and copy the CSS code
output:
  html:
    meta:
      css: ["@default"]
    options:
      toc: true
---

Change the settings below, and the page will update right away. Only the
settings you have changed appear in the CSS code, which you can copy into a CSS
chunk in your document, or into a `.css` file listed in the `css` field of the
YAML metadata.

```{css, echo = FALSE}
#ui {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(13em, 1fr));
  gap: .5em 1em;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  padding: 1em;
  label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: .9em; }
  input, select { width: 100%; }
}
```

## Settings

<form id="ui">
<label>Font family
<select data-sel="body" data-prop="font-family">
<option value="">Default</option>
<option value="Georgia, serif">Serif</option>
<option value="system-ui, sans-serif">System UI</option>
<option value="ui-monospace, monospace">Monospace</option>
</select></label>
<label>Font size (px)
<input type="range" min="12" max="24" data-sel="body" data-prop="font-size" data-unit="px"></label>
<label>Line height
<input type="range" min="1" max="2.2" step=".1" data-sel="body" data-prop="line-height"></label>
<label>Page width (px)
<input type="range" min="500" max="1200" step="20" data-sel="body" data-prop="max-width" data-unit="px"></label>
<label>Text color
<input type="color" data-sel="body" data-prop="color"></label>
<label>Background color
<input type="color" data-sel="body" data-prop="background"></label>
<label>Link color
<input type="color" data-sel="a" data-prop="color"></label>
<label>Heading color
<input type="color" data-sel="h1, h2, h3" data-prop="color" data-read="h2"></label>
<p><button type="reset">Reset</button> <button type="button" id="copy">Copy CSS</button></p>
</form>

## Preview

This section shows how some common elements look. Here is a
[link](https://yihui.org/litedown/), some `inline code`, and a quote:

> A block quote is a good place to quote someone.

```{r}
summary(cars$speed)
```

```{r}
#| tab.cap = 'First 3 rows of the `cars` data.'
head(cars, 3)
```

```{js, echo = FALSE}
const d = document, ui = d.getElementById('ui'), out = d.getElementById('out');
const inputs = [...ui.querySelectorAll('[data-prop]')];
const style = d.head.appendChild(d.createElement('style'));
const hex = c => '#' + c.match(/\d+/g).slice(0, 3)
  .map(i => (+i).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');

// initialize inputs with the current computed style
inputs.forEach(el => {
  const t = d.querySelector(el.dataset.read || el.dataset.sel);
  const cs = getComputedStyle(t), p = el.dataset.prop;
  if (el.type === 'color') {
    el.value = hex(cs[p === 'background' ? 'backgroundColor' : p]);
    // a transparent background means white
    if (p === 'background' && cs.backgroundColor.endsWith('0)')) el.value = '#ffffff';
  } else if (el.type === 'range') {
    el.value = p === 'line-height' ?
      Math.round(parseFloat(cs.lineHeight) / parseFloat(cs.fontSize) * 10) / 10 :
      parseFloat(cs[p === 'max-width' ? 'maxWidth' : 'fontSize']);
  }
  el.dataset.init = el.value;
});

function update() {
  const rules = {};
  inputs.forEach(el => {
    if (el.value === el.dataset.init) return;
    (rules[el.dataset.sel] ??= []).push(
      `  ${el.dataset.prop}: ${el.value}${el.dataset.unit || ''};`
    );
  });
  const css = Object.entries(rules)
    .map(([s, v]) => `${s} {\n${v.join('\n')}\n}`).join('\n');
  style.textContent = css;
  out.textContent = css || '/* Change a setting above to generate CSS. */';
}
ui.addEventListener('input', update);
ui.addEventListener('reset', () => setTimeout(update));
d.getElementById('copy').onclick = () => navigator.clipboard.writeText(style.textContent);
update();
```
